title: Norse Atlantic risks losing all 12 Dreamliners as funding crisis threatens bankruptcy
summary_full: Norse Atlantic Airways finds itself in dire straits, grappling with severe financial challenges stemming from lease terminations for its Boeing 787 fleet. After halting all operations on November 26 due to a precarious cash position, the airline is now on the brink of bankruptcy. Amidst disputes over lease validity and the pursuit of emergency funding, its stock has plummeted, leaving its future operations hanging in the balance.
